lead.headline: Zvada's 2 is the hole — and Maye is out of his game
lead.deck: Every noon starter is active. Maye-day lost their quarterback in Munich; ESPN has you at 70%.
lead.body: Dominic Zvada, added Thursday for Matt Gay, kicked two points; Gay plays at Las Vegas this afternoon, and anything above 2.0 makes that swap a loss. That is the bad news, and it is banked. The rest broke your way: Taylor, Tuten, Golden, Rice and Gordon are all active after the 10:30 lists, and Garrett Wilson is officially active but stays on the bench, 0.6 behind Rice — a coin flip. Maye-day's Drake Maye left the Munich game with an ankle injury and is done for the day; Tommy DeVito finishes. Nothing to tap.
